CustomField.description: Response-time commitment derived from Priority. Formula rather than a stored field so a priority change cannot leave a stale deadline behind.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), "P1 Emergency", CreatedDate + 4/24, "P2 Urgent", CreatedDate + 1, "P3 Standard", CreatedDate + 5, CreatedDate + 30)
CustomField.label: Response Due
